title: airflow-variable-name-task-id-mismatch (AIR001)
description:
Checks that the task variable name matches the task_id value for
Airflow Operators.

title: airflow-dag-no-schedule-argument (AIR002)
description:
Checks for a DAG() class or @dag() decorator without an explicit
schedule (or schedule_interval for Airflow 1) parameter.

title: airflow-variable-get-outside-task (AIR003)
description:
Checks for Variable.get() calls outside of Airflow task execution
context (i.e., outside @task-decorated functions and operator
execute() methods).

title: airflow-task-branch-as-short-circuit (AIR004)
description:
Checks for branching logic that could be replaced with a short-circuit
pattern, either via @task.branch decorated functions or
BranchPythonOperator callables.

title: airflow-xcom-pull-in-template-string (AIR201)
description:
Checks for Airflow operator keyword arguments that use a Jinja template
string containing a single xcom_pull call to retrieve another task's
output.

title: airflow-task-implicit-multiple-outputs (AIR202)
description:
Checks for @task-decorated functions whose multiple_outputs behavior is
determined by Airflow's runtime inference rather than being set explicitly.

title: airflow3-removal (AIR301)
description: Checks for uses of deprecated Airflow functions and values.

title: airflow3-moved-to-provider (AIR302)
description:
Checks for uses of Airflow functions and values that have been moved to its providers
(e.g., apache-airflow-providers-fab).

title: airflow3-incompatible-function-signature (AIR303)
description:
Checks for Airflow function calls that will raise a runtime error in Airflow 3.0
due to function signature changes, such as functions that changed to accept only
keyword arguments, parameter reordering, or parameter type changes.

title: airflow3-dag-dynamic-value (AIR304)
description:
Checks for calls to runtime-varying functions (such as datetime.now())
used as arguments in Airflow Dag or task constructors.

title: airflow3-suggested-update (AIR311)
description:
Checks for uses of deprecated Airflow functions and values that still have
a compatibility layer.

title: airflow3-suggested-to-move-to-provider (AIR312)
description:
Checks for uses of Airflow functions and values that have been moved to its providers
but still have a compatibility layer (e.g., apache-airflow-providers-standard).

title: airflow31-moved (AIR321)
description: Checks for uses of deprecated or moved Airflow functions and values in Airflow 3.1.

title: commented-out-code (ERA001)
description: Checks for commented-out Python code.

title: fast-api-redundant-response-model (FAST001)
description:
Checks for FastAPI routes that use the optional response_model parameter
with the same type as the return type.

title: fast-api-non-annotated-dependency (FAST002)
description: Identifies FastAPI routes with deprecated uses of Depends or similar.

title: fast-api-unused-path-parameter (FAST003)
description:
Identifies FastAPI routes that declare path parameters in the route path
that are not included in the function signature.

title: sys-version-slice3 (YTT101)
description: Checks for uses of sys.version[:3].

title: sys-version2 (YTT102)
description: Checks for uses of sys.version[2].

title: sys-version-cmp-str3 (YTT103)
description:
Checks for comparisons that test sys.version against string literals,
such that the comparison will evaluate to False on Python 3.10 or later.

title: sys-version-info0-eq3 (YTT201)
description:
Checks for equality comparisons against the major version returned by
sys.version_info (e.g., sys.version_info[0] == 3 or sys.version_info[0] != 3).

title: six-py3 (YTT202)
description: Checks for uses of six.PY3.

title: sys-version-info1-cmp-int (YTT203)
description: Checks for comparisons that test sys.version_info[1] against an integer.

title: sys-version-info-minor-cmp-int (YTT204)
description: Checks for comparisons that test sys.version_info.minor against an integer.

title: sys-version0 (YTT301)
description: Checks for uses of sys.version[0].

title: sys-version-cmp-str10 (YTT302)
description:
Checks for comparisons that test sys.version against string literals,
such that the comparison would fail if the major version number were
ever incremented to Python 10 or higher.

title: sys-version-slice1 (YTT303)
description: Checks for uses of sys.version[:1].

title: missing-type-function-argument (ANN001)
description: Checks that function arguments have type annotations.

title: missing-type-args (ANN002)
description: Checks that function *args arguments have type annotations.

title: missing-type-kwargs (ANN003)
description: Checks that function **kwargs arguments have type annotations.

title: missing-return-type-undocumented-public-function (ANN201)
description: Checks that public functions and methods have return type annotations.

title: missing-return-type-private-function (ANN202)
description: Checks that private functions and methods have return type annotations.

title: missing-return-type-special-method (ANN204)
description:
Checks that "special" methods, like __init__, __new__, and __call__, have
return type annotations.

title: missing-return-type-static-method (ANN205)
description: Checks that static methods have return type annotations.

title: missing-return-type-class-method (ANN206)
description: Checks that class methods have return type annotations.

title: any-type (ANN401)
description:
Checks that function arguments are annotated with a more specific type than
Any.

title: cancel-scope-no-checkpoint (ASYNC100)
description:
Checks for timeout context managers which do not contain a checkpoint.
For the purposes of this check, yield is considered a checkpoint,
since checkpoints may occur in the caller to which we yield.

title: trio-sync-call (ASYNC105)
description: Checks for calls to trio functions that are not immediately awaited.

title: async-function-with-timeout (ASYNC109)
description: Checks for async function definitions with timeout parameters.

title: async-busy-wait (ASYNC110)
description: Checks for the use of an async sleep function in a while loop.

title: async-zero-sleep (ASYNC115)
description: Checks for uses of trio.sleep(0) or anyio.sleep(0).

title: long-sleep-not-forever (ASYNC116)
description: Checks for uses of trio.sleep() or anyio.sleep() with a delay greater than 24 hours.

title: yield-in-context-manager-in-async-generator (ASYNC119)
description: Checks for yield inside a context manager in an async generator.

title: blocking-http-call-in-async-function (ASYNC210)
description: Checks that async functions do not contain blocking HTTP calls.

title: blocking-http-call-httpx-in-async-function (ASYNC212)
description: Checks that async functions do not use blocking httpx clients.

title: create-subprocess-in-async-function (ASYNC220)
description: Checks that async functions do not create subprocesses with blocking methods.

title: run-process-in-async-function (ASYNC221)
description: Checks that async functions do not run processes with blocking methods.

title: wait-for-process-in-async-function (ASYNC222)
description: Checks that async functions do not wait on processes with blocking methods.

title: blocking-open-call-in-async-function (ASYNC230)
description: Checks that async functions do not open files with blocking methods like open.

title: blocking-path-method-in-async-function (ASYNC240)
description:
Checks that async functions do not call blocking os.path or pathlib.Path
methods.

title: blocking-input-in-async-function (ASYNC250)
description: Checks that async functions do not contain blocking usage of input from user.

title: blocking-sleep-in-async-function (ASYNC251)
description: Checks that async functions do not call time.sleep.

title: assert (S101)
description: Checks for uses of the assert keyword.

title: exec-builtin (S102)
description: Checks for uses of the builtin exec function.

title: bad-file-permissions (S103)
description: Checks for files with overly permissive permissions.

title: hardcoded-bind-all-interfaces (S104)
description: Checks for hardcoded bindings to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0).

title: hardcoded-password-string (S105)
description: Checks for potential uses of hardcoded passwords in strings.

title: hardcoded-password-func-arg (S106)
description: Checks for potential uses of hardcoded passwords in function calls.

title: hardcoded-password-default (S107)
description:
Checks for potential uses of hardcoded passwords in function argument
defaults.

title: hardcoded-temp-file (S108)
description: Checks for the use of hardcoded temporary file or directory paths.

title: try-except-pass (S110)
description: Checks for uses of the try-except-pass pattern.

title: try-except-continue (S112)
description: Checks for uses of the try-except-continue pattern.

title: request-without-timeout (S113)
description:
Checks for uses of the Python requests or httpx module that omit the
timeout parameter.

title: flask-debug-true (S201)
description: Checks for uses of debug=True in Flask.

title: tarfile-unsafe-members (S202)
description: Checks for uses of tarfile.extractall.

title: suspicious-pickle-usage (S301)
description: Checks for calls to pickle functions or modules that wrap them.

title: suspicious-marshal-usage (S302)
description: Checks for calls to marshal functions.

title: suspicious-insecure-hash-usage (S303)

title: suspicious-insecure-cipher-usage (S304)
description: Checks for uses of weak or broken cryptographic ciphers.

title: suspicious-insecure-cipher-mode-usage (S305)
description: Checks for uses of weak or broken cryptographic cipher modes.

title: suspicious-mktemp-usage (S306)
description: Checks for uses of tempfile.mktemp.

title: suspicious-eval-usage (S307)
description: Checks for uses of the builtin eval() function.

title: suspicious-mark-safe-usage (S308)
description: Checks for uses of calls to django.utils.safestring.mark_safe.

title: suspicious-url-open-usage (S310)
description: Checks for instances where URL open functions are used with unexpected schemes.

title: suspicious-non-cryptographic-random-usage (S311)
description: Checks for uses of cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generators.

title: suspicious-telnet-usage (S312)
description: Checks for the use of Telnet-related functions.

title: suspicious-xmlc-element-tree-usage (S313)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-xml-element-tree-usage (S314)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-xml-expat-reader-usage (S315)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-xml-expat-builder-usage (S316)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-xml-sax-usage (S317)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-xml-mini-dom-usage (S318)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-xml-pull-dom-usage (S319)
description: Checks for uses of insecure XML parsers.

title: suspicious-ftp-lib-usage (S321)
description: Checks for the use of FTP-related functions.

title: suspicious-unverified-context-usage (S323)
description: Checks for uses of ssl._create_unverified_context.

title: hashlib-insecure-hash-function (S324)
description:
Checks for uses of weak or broken cryptographic hash functions in
hashlib and crypt libraries.

title: suspicious-telnetlib-import (S401)
description: Checks for imports of the telnetlib module.

title: suspicious-ftplib-import (S402)
description: Checks for imports of the ftplib module.

title: suspicious-pickle-import (S403)
description: Checks for imports of the pickle, cPickle, dill, and shelve modules.

title: suspicious-subprocess-import (S404)
description: Checks for imports of the subprocess module.

title: suspicious-xml-etree-import (S405)
description: Checks for imports of the xml.etree.cElementTree and xml.etree.ElementTree modules

title: suspicious-xml-sax-import (S406)
description: Checks for imports of the xml.sax module.

title: suspicious-xml-expat-import (S407)
description: Checks for imports of the xml.dom.expatbuilder module.

title: suspicious-xml-minidom-import (S408)
description: Checks for imports of the xml.dom.minidom module.

title: suspicious-xml-pulldom-import (S409)
description: Checks for imports of the xml.dom.pulldom module.

title: suspicious-xmlrpc-import (S411)
description: Checks for imports of the xmlrpc module.

title: suspicious-httpoxy-import (S412)
description:
Checks for imports of wsgiref.handlers.CGIHandler and
twisted.web.twcgi.CGIScript.

title: suspicious-pycrypto-import (S413)
description: Checks for imports of several unsafe cryptography modules.

title: suspicious-pyghmi-import (S415)
description: Checks for imports of the pyghmi module.

title: request-with-no-cert-validation (S501)
description: Checks for HTTPS requests that disable SSL certificate checks.

title: ssl-insecure-version (S502)
description:
Checks for function calls with parameters that indicate the use of insecure
SSL and TLS protocol versions.

title: ssl-with-bad-defaults (S503)
description:
Checks for function definitions with default arguments set to insecure SSL
and TLS protocol versions.

title: ssl-with-no-version (S504)
description: Checks for calls to ssl.wrap_socket() without an ssl_version.

title: weak-cryptographic-key (S505)
description: Checks for uses of cryptographic keys with vulnerable key sizes.

title: unsafe-yaml-load (S506)
description: Checks for uses of the yaml.load function.

title: ssh-no-host-key-verification (S507)
description: Checks for uses of policies disabling SSH verification in Paramiko.

title: snmp-insecure-version (S508)
description: Checks for uses of SNMPv1 or SNMPv2.

title: snmp-weak-cryptography (S509)
description: Checks for uses of the SNMPv3 protocol without encryption.

title: paramiko-call (S601)
description: Checks for paramiko calls.

title: subprocess-popen-with-shell-equals-true (S602)
description: Check for method calls that initiate a subprocess with a shell.

title: subprocess-without-shell-equals-true (S603)
description: Check for method calls that initiate a subprocess without a shell.

title: call-with-shell-equals-true (S604)
description:
Checks for method calls that set the shell parameter to true or another
truthy value when invoking a subprocess.

title: start-process-with-a-shell (S605)
description:
Checks for calls that start a process with a shell, providing guidance on
whether the usage is safe or not.

title: start-process-with-no-shell (S606)
description: Checks for functions that start a process without a shell.

title: start-process-with-partial-path (S607)
description: Checks for the starting of a process with a partial executable path.

title: hardcoded-sql-expression (S608)
description:
Checks for strings that resemble SQL statements involved in some form
string building operation.

title: unix-command-wildcard-injection (S609)
description: Checks for possible wildcard injections in calls to subprocess.Popen().

title: django-extra (S610)
description:
Checks for uses of Django's extra function where one or more arguments
passed are not literal expressions.

title: django-raw-sql (S611)
description: Checks for uses of Django's RawSQL function.

title: logging-config-insecure-listen (S612)
description: Checks for insecure logging.config.listen calls.

title: jinja2-autoescape-false (S701)
description: Checks for jinja2 templates that use autoescape=False.

title: mako-templates (S702)
description: Checks for uses of the mako templates.

title: unsafe-markup-use (S704)
description: Checks for non-literal strings being passed to markupsafe.Markup.

title: blind-except (BLE001)
description:
Checks for except clauses that catch all exceptions. This includes
except BaseException and except Exception.

title: boolean-type-hint-positional-argument (FBT001)
description:
Checks for the use of boolean positional arguments in function definitions,
as determined by the presence of a type hint containing bool as an
evident subtype - e.g. bool, bool | int, typing.Optional[bool], etc.

title: boolean-default-value-positional-argument (FBT002)
description:
Checks for the use of boolean positional arguments in function definitions,
as determined by the presence of a boolean default value.

title: boolean-positional-value-in-call (FBT003)
description:
Checks for boolean positional arguments in function calls.
Some functions are whitelisted by default. To extend the list of allowed calls
configure the lint.flake8-boolean-trap.extend-allowed-calls option.

title: unary-prefix-increment-decrement (B002)
description:
Checks for the attempted use of the unary prefix increment (++) or
decrement operator (--).

title: assignment-to-os-environ (B003)
description: Checks for assignments to os.environ.

title: unreliable-callable-check (B004)
description:
Checks for uses of hasattr to test if an object is callable (e.g.,
hasattr(obj, "__call__")).

title: strip-with-multi-characters (B005)
description:
Checks for uses of multi-character strings in .strip(), .lstrip(), and
.rstrip() calls.

title: mutable-argument-default (B006)
description: Checks for uses of mutable objects as function argument defaults.

title: unused-loop-control-variable (B007)
description: Checks for unused variables in loops (e.g., for and while statements).

title: function-call-in-default-argument (B008)
description: Checks for function calls in default function arguments.

title: get-attr-with-constant (B009)
description:
Checks for uses of getattr that take a constant attribute value as an
argument (e.g., getattr(obj, "foo")).

title: set-attr-with-constant (B010)
description:
Checks for uses of setattr that take a constant attribute value as an
argument (e.g., setattr(obj, "foo", 42)).

title: assert-false (B011)
description: Checks for uses of assert False.

title: jump-statement-in-finally (B012)
description:
Checks for break, continue, and return statements in finally
blocks.

title: redundant-tuple-in-exception-handler (B013)
description:
Checks for single-element tuples in exception handlers (e.g.,
except (ValueError,):).
Note: Single-element tuples consisting of a starred expression
are allowed.

title: duplicate-handler-exception (B014)
description: Checks for exception handlers that catch duplicate exceptions.

title: useless-comparison (B015)
description: Checks for useless comparisons.

title: raise-literal (B016)
description: Checks for raise statements that raise a literal value.

title: assert-raises-exception (B017)
description:
Checks for assertRaises and pytest.raises context managers that catch
Exception or BaseException.

title: useless-expression (B018)
description: Checks for useless expressions.

title: cached-instance-method (B019)
description:
Checks for uses of the functools.lru_cache and functools.cache
decorators on methods.

title: loop-variable-overrides-iterator (B020)
description: Checks for loop control variables that override the loop iterable.

title: f-string-docstring (B021)
description: Checks for docstrings that are written via f-strings.

title: useless-contextlib-suppress (B022)
description: Checks for contextlib.suppress without arguments.

title: function-uses-loop-variable (B023)
description: Checks for function definitions that use a loop variable.

title: abstract-base-class-without-abstract-method (B024)
description:
Checks for abstract classes without abstract methods or properties.
Annotated but unassigned class variables are regarded as abstract.

title: duplicate-try-block-exception (B025)
description: Checks for try-except blocks with duplicate exception handlers.

title: star-arg-unpacking-after-keyword-arg (B026)
description:
Checks for function calls that use star-argument unpacking after providing a
keyword argument

title: empty-method-without-abstract-decorator (B027)
description:
Checks for empty methods in abstract base classes without an abstract
decorator.

title: no-explicit-stacklevel (B028)
description:
Checks for warnings.warn calls without an explicit stacklevel keyword
argument.

title: except-with-empty-tuple (B029)
description: Checks for exception handlers that catch an empty tuple.

title: except-with-non-exception-classes (B030)
description: Checks for exception handlers that catch non-exception classes.

title: reuse-of-groupby-generator (B031)
description:
Checks for multiple usage of the generator returned from
itertools.groupby().

title: unintentional-type-annotation (B032)
description: Checks for the unintentional use of type annotations.

title: duplicate-value (B033)
description: Checks for set literals that contain duplicate items.

title: re-sub-positional-args (B034)
description:
Checks for calls to re.sub, re.subn, and re.split that pass count,
maxsplit, or flags as positional arguments.

title: static-key-dict-comprehension (B035)
description:
Checks for dictionary comprehensions that use a static key, like a string
literal or a variable defined outside the comprehension.

title: mutable-contextvar-default (B039)
description: Checks for uses of mutable objects as ContextVar defaults.

title: del-attr-with-constant (B043)
description:
Checks for uses of delattr that take a constant attribute value as an
argument (e.g., delattr(obj, "foo")).

title: return-in-generator (B901)
description:
Checks for return {value} statements in functions that also contain yield
or yield from statements.

title: class-as-data-structure (B903)
description:
Checks for classes that only have a public __init__ method,
without base classes and decorators.

title: raise-without-from-inside-except (B904)
description:
Checks for raise statements in exception handlers that lack a from
clause.

title: zip-without-explicit-strict (B905)
description: Checks for zip calls without an explicit strict parameter when called with two or more iterables, or any starred argument.

title: loop-iterator-mutation (B909)
description: Checks for mutations to an iterable during a loop iteration.

title: batched-without-explicit-strict (B911)
description: Checks for itertools.batched calls without an explicit strict parameter.

title: map-without-explicit-strict (B912)
description:
Checks for map calls without an explicit strict parameter when called with two or more
iterables, or any starred argument.
This rule applies to Python 3.14 and later, where map accepts a strict keyword
argument. For details, see: [What’s New in Python 3.14].

title: builtin-variable-shadowing (A001)
description:
Checks for variable (and function) assignments that use the same names
as builtins.

title: builtin-argument-shadowing (A002)
description: Checks for function arguments that use the same names as builtins.

title: builtin-attribute-shadowing (A003)
description:
Checks for class attributes and methods that use the same names as
Python builtins.

title: builtin-import-shadowing (A004)
description: Checks for imports that use the same names as builtins.

title: stdlib-module-shadowing (A005)
description:
Checks for modules that use the same names as Python standard-library
modules.

title: builtin-lambda-argument-shadowing (A006)
description: Checks for lambda arguments that use the same names as Python builtins.

title: missing-trailing-comma (COM812)
description: Checks for the absence of trailing commas.

title: trailing-comma-on-bare-tuple (COM818)
description:
Checks for the presence of trailing commas on bare (i.e., unparenthesized)
tuples.

title: prohibited-trailing-comma (COM819)
description: Checks for the presence of prohibited trailing commas.

title: unnecessary-generator-list (C400)
description:
Checks for unnecessary generators that can be rewritten as list
comprehensions (or with list() directly).

title: unnecessary-generator-set (C401)
description:
Checks for unnecessary generators that can be rewritten as set
comprehensions (or with set() directly).

title: unnecessary-generator-dict (C402)
description:
Checks for unnecessary generators that can be rewritten as dict
comprehensions.

title: unnecessary-list-comprehension-set (C403)
description: Checks for unnecessary list comprehensions.

title: unnecessary-list-comprehension-dict (C404)
description: Checks for unnecessary list comprehensions.

title: unnecessary-literal-set (C405)
description:
Checks for set() calls that take unnecessary list or tuple literals
as arguments.

title: unnecessary-literal-dict (C406)
description: Checks for unnecessary list or tuple literals.

title: unnecessary-collection-call (C408)
description:
Checks for unnecessary dict(), list() or tuple() calls that can be
rewritten as empty literals.

title: unnecessary-literal-within-tuple-call (C409)
description:
Checks for tuple calls that take unnecessary list or tuple literals as
arguments.

title: unnecessary-literal-within-list-call (C410)
description:
Checks for list() calls that take unnecessary list or tuple literals as
arguments.

title: unnecessary-list-call (C411)
description: Checks for unnecessary list() calls around list comprehensions.

title: unnecessary-call-around-sorted (C413)
description:
Checks for unnecessary list() or reversed() calls around sorted()
calls.

title: unnecessary-double-cast-or-process (C414)
description:
Checks for unnecessary list(), reversed(), set(), sorted(), and
tuple() call within list(), set(), sorted(), and tuple() calls.

title: unnecessary-subscript-reversal (C415)
description: Checks for unnecessary subscript reversal of iterable.

title: unnecessary-comprehension (C416)
description: Checks for unnecessary dict, list, and set comprehension.

title: unnecessary-map (C417)
description: Checks for unnecessary map() calls with lambda functions.

title: unnecessary-literal-within-dict-call (C418)
description:
Checks for dict() calls that take unnecessary dict literals or dict
comprehensions as arguments.

title: unnecessary-comprehension-in-call (C419)
description:
Checks for unnecessary list or set comprehensions passed to builtin functions that take an iterable.
Set comprehensions are only a violation in the case where the builtin function does not care about
duplication of elements in the passed iterable.

title: unnecessary-dict-comprehension-for-iterable (C420)
description:
Checks for unnecessary dict comprehension when creating a dictionary from
an iterable.

title: missing-copyright-notice (CPY001)
description:
Checks for the absence of copyright notices within Python files.
Note that this check only searches within the first 4096 bytes of the file.

title: call-datetime-without-tzinfo (DTZ001)
description: Checks for datetime instantiations that do not specify a timezone.

title: call-datetime-today (DTZ002)
description: Checks for usage of datetime.datetime.today().

title: call-datetime-utcnow (DTZ003)
description: Checks for usage of datetime.datetime.utcnow().

title: call-datetime-utcfromtimestamp (DTZ004)
description: Checks for usage of datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp().

title: call-datetime-now-without-tzinfo (DTZ005)
description: Checks for usages of datetime.datetime.now() that do not specify a timezone.

title: call-datetime-fromtimestamp (DTZ006)
description:
Checks for usage of datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp() that do not specify
a timezone.

title: call-datetime-strptime-without-zone (DTZ007)
description:
Checks for uses of datetime.datetime.strptime() that lead to naive
datetime objects.

title: call-date-today (DTZ011)
description: Checks for usage of datetime.date.today().

title: call-date-fromtimestamp (DTZ012)
description: Checks for usage of datetime.date.fromtimestamp().

title: datetime-min-max (DTZ901)
description: Checks for uses of datetime.datetime.min and datetime.datetime.max.

title: debugger (T100)
description: Checks for the presence of debugger calls and imports.

title: django-nullable-model-string-field (DJ001)
description:
Checks nullable string-based fields (like CharField and TextField)
in Django models.

title: django-locals-in-render-function (DJ003)
description: Checks for the use of locals() in render functions.

title: django-exclude-with-model-form (DJ006)
description: Checks for the use of exclude in Django ModelForm classes.

title: django-all-with-model-form (DJ007)
description:
Checks for the use of fields = "__all__" in Django ModelForm
classes.

title: django-model-without-dunder-str (DJ008)
description: Checks that a __str__ method is defined in Django models.

title: django-unordered-body-content-in-model (DJ012)
description:
Checks for the order of Model's inner classes, methods, and fields as per
the Django Style Guide.

title: django-non-leading-receiver-decorator (DJ013)
description:
Checks that Django's @receiver decorator is listed first, prior to
any other decorators.

title: raw-string-in-exception (EM101)
description: Checks for the use of string literals in exception constructors.

title: f-string-in-exception (EM102)
description: Checks for the use of f-strings in exception constructors.

title: dot-format-in-exception (EM103)
description:
Checks for the use of .format calls on string literals in exception
constructors.

title: shebang-not-executable (EXE001)
description: Checks for a shebang directive in a file that is not executable.

title: shebang-missing-executable-file (EXE002)
description: Checks for executable .py files that do not have a shebang.

title: shebang-missing-python (EXE003)
description:
Checks for a shebang directive in .py files that does not contain python,
pytest, or uv run.

title: shebang-leading-whitespace (EXE004)
description: Checks for whitespace before a shebang directive.

title: shebang-not-first-line (EXE005)
description: Checks for a shebang directive that is not at the beginning of the file.

title: line-contains-fixme (FIX001)
description: Checks for "FIXME" comments.

title: line-contains-todo (FIX002)
description: Checks for "TODO" comments.

title: line-contains-xxx (FIX003)
description: Checks for "XXX" comments.

title: line-contains-hack (FIX004)
description: Checks for "HACK" comments.

title: future-rewritable-type-annotation (FA100)
description:
Checks for missing from __future__ import annotations imports upon
detecting type annotations that can be written more succinctly under
PEP 563.

title: future-required-type-annotation (FA102)
description:
Checks for uses of PEP 585- and PEP 604-style type annotations in Python
modules that lack the required from __future__ import annotations import
for compatibility with older Python versions.

title: f-string-in-get-text-func-call (INT001)
description: Checks for f-strings in gettext function calls.

title: format-in-get-text-func-call (INT002)
description: Checks for str.format calls in gettext function calls.

title: printf-in-get-text-func-call (INT003)
description: Checks for printf-style formatted strings in gettext function calls.

title: single-line-implicit-string-concatenation (ISC001)
description: Checks for implicitly concatenated strings on a single line.

title: multi-line-implicit-string-concatenation (ISC002)
description: Checks for implicitly concatenated strings that span multiple lines.

title: explicit-string-concatenation (ISC003)
description:
Checks for string literals that are explicitly concatenated (using the
+ operator).

title: implicit-string-concatenation-in-collection-literal (ISC004)
description: Checks for implicitly concatenated strings inside list, tuple, and set literals.

title: unconventional-import-alias (ICN001)
description:
Checks for imports that are typically imported using a common convention,
like import pandas as pd, and enforces that convention.

title: banned-import-alias (ICN002)
description:
Checks for imports that use non-standard naming conventions, like
import tensorflow.keras.backend as K.

title: banned-import-from (ICN003)
description:
Checks for member imports that should instead be accessed by importing the
module.

title: direct-logger-instantiation (LOG001)
description:
Checks for direct instantiation of logging.Logger, as opposed to using
logging.getLogger().

title: invalid-get-logger-argument (LOG002)
description:
Checks for any usage of __cached__ and __file__ as an argument to
logging.getLogger().

title: log-exception-outside-except-handler (LOG004)
description: Checks for .exception() logging calls outside of exception handlers.

title: exception-without-exc-info (LOG007)
description: Checks for uses of logging.exception() with exc_info set to False.

title: undocumented-warn (LOG009)
description: Checks for uses of logging.WARN.

title: exc-info-outside-except-handler (LOG014)
description: Checks for logging calls with exc_info= outside exception handlers.

title: root-logger-call (LOG015)
description:
Checks for usages of the following logging top-level functions:
debug, info, warn, warning, error, critical, log, exception.

title: logging-string-format (G001)
description: Checks for uses of str.format to format logging messages.

title: logging-percent-format (G002)
description:
Checks for uses of printf-style format strings to format logging
messages.

title: logging-string-concat (G003)
description:
Checks for uses string concatenation via the + operator to format logging
messages.

title: logging-f-string (G004)
description: Checks for uses of f-strings to format logging messages.

title: logging-warn (G010)
description: Checks for uses of logging.warn and logging.Logger.warn.

title: logging-extra-attr-clash (G101)
description:
Checks for extra keywords in logging statements that clash with
LogRecord attributes.

title: logging-exc-info (G201)
description: Checks for uses of logging.error that pass exc_info=True.

title: logging-redundant-exc-info (G202)
description: Checks for redundant exc_info keyword arguments in logging statements.

title: implicit-namespace-package (INP001)
description: Checks for packages that are missing an __init__.py file.

title: unnecessary-placeholder (PIE790)
description:
Checks for unnecessary pass statements and ellipsis (...) literals in
functions, classes, and other blocks.

title: duplicate-class-field-definition (PIE794)
description: Checks for duplicate field definitions in classes.

title: non-unique-enums (PIE796)
description: Checks for enums that contain duplicate values.

title: unnecessary-spread (PIE800)
description: Checks for unnecessary dictionary unpacking operators (**).

title: unnecessary-dict-kwargs (PIE804)
description: Checks for unnecessary dict kwargs.

title: reimplemented-container-builtin (PIE807)
description: Checks for lambdas that can be replaced with the list or dict builtins.

title: unnecessary-range-start (PIE808)
description: Checks for range calls with an unnecessary start argument.

title: multiple-starts-ends-with (PIE810)
description:
Checks for startswith or endswith calls on the same value with
different prefixes or suffixes.

title: print (T201)
description: Checks for print statements.

title: p-print (T203)
description: Checks for pprint statements.

title: unprefixed-type-param (PYI001)
description:
Checks that type TypeVars, ParamSpecs, and TypeVarTuples in stubs
have names prefixed with _.

title: complex-if-statement-in-stub (PYI002)
description: Checks for if statements with complex conditionals in stubs.

title: unrecognized-version-info-check (PYI003)
description: Checks for problematic sys.version_info-related conditions in stubs.

title: patch-version-comparison (PYI004)
description:
Checks for Python version comparisons in stubs that compare against patch
versions (e.g., Python 3.8.3) instead of major and minor versions (e.g.,
Python 3.8).

title: wrong-tuple-length-version-comparison (PYI005)
description:
Checks for Python version comparisons that compare against a tuple of the
wrong length.

title: bad-version-info-comparison (PYI006)
description:
Checks for uses of comparators other than < and >= for
sys.version_info checks. All other comparators, such
as >, <=, and ==, are banned.

title: unrecognized-platform-check (PYI007)
description:
Check for unrecognized sys.platform checks. Platform checks should be
simple string comparisons.
Note: this rule is only enabled in .pyi stub files.

title: unrecognized-platform-name (PYI008)
description:
Check for unrecognized platform names in sys.platform checks.
Note: this rule is only enabled in .pyi stub files.

title: pass-statement-stub-body (PYI009)
description: Checks for pass statements in empty stub bodies.

title: non-empty-stub-body (PYI010)
description: Checks for non-empty function stub bodies.

title: typed-argument-default-in-stub (PYI011)
description: Checks for typed function arguments in stubs with complex default values.

title: pass-in-class-body (PYI012)
description:
Checks for the presence of the pass statement in non-empty class bodies
in .pyi files.

title: ellipsis-in-non-empty-class-body (PYI013)
description: Removes ellipses (...) in otherwise non-empty class bodies.

title: argument-default-in-stub (PYI014)
description:
Checks for untyped function arguments in stubs with default values that
are not "simple" /// (i.e., int, float, complex, bytes, str,
bool, None, ..., or simple container literals).

title: assignment-default-in-stub (PYI015)
description:
Checks for assignments in stubs with default values that are not "simple"
(i.e., int, float, complex, bytes, str, bool, None, ..., or
simple container literals).

title: duplicate-union-member (PYI016)
description: Checks for duplicate union members.

title: complex-assignment-in-stub (PYI017)
description: Checks for assignments with multiple or non-name targets in stub files.

title: unused-private-type-var (PYI018)
description:
Checks for the presence of unused private TypeVar, ParamSpec or
TypeVarTuple declarations.

title: custom-type-var-for-self (PYI019)
description:
Checks for methods that use custom TypeVars in their
annotations when they could use Self instead.

title: quoted-annotation-in-stub (PYI020)
description: Checks for quoted type annotations in stub (.pyi) files, which should be avoided.

title: docstring-in-stub (PYI021)
description: Checks for the presence of docstrings in stub files.

title: collections-named-tuple (PYI024)
description: Checks for uses of collections.namedtuple in stub files.

title: unaliased-collections-abc-set-import (PYI025)
description:
Checks for from collections.abc import Set imports that do not alias
Set to AbstractSet.

title: type-alias-without-annotation (PYI026)
description:
Checks for type alias definitions that are not annotated with
typing.TypeAlias.

title: str-or-repr-defined-in-stub (PYI029)
description: Checks for redundant definitions of __str__ or __repr__ in stubs.

title: unnecessary-literal-union (PYI030)
description: Checks for the presence of multiple literal types in a union.

title: any-eq-ne-annotation (PYI032)
description:
Checks for __eq__ and __ne__ implementations that use typing.Any as
the type annotation for their second parameter.

title: legacy-type-comment (PYI033)
description:
Checks for the use of type comments (e.g., x = 1  # type: int).
By default, this check only runs on stub files. If preview mode is enabled,
the check also runs on .py files.

title: non-self-return-type (PYI034)
description:
Checks for methods that are annotated with a fixed return type which
should instead be returning Self.

title: unassigned-special-variable-in-stub (PYI035)
description:
Checks that __all__, __match_args__, and __slots__ variables are
assigned to values when defined in stub files.

title: bad-exit-annotation (PYI036)
description:
Checks for incorrect function signatures on __exit__ and __aexit__
methods.

title: redundant-numeric-union (PYI041)
description:
Checks for parameter annotations that contain redundant unions between
builtin numeric types (e.g., int | float).

title: snake-case-type-alias (PYI042)
description: Checks for type aliases that do not use the CamelCase naming convention.

title: t-suffixed-type-alias (PYI043)
description: Checks for private type alias definitions suffixed with 'T'.

title: future-annotations-in-stub (PYI044)
description:
Checks for the presence of the from __future__ import annotations import
statement in stub files.

title: iter-method-return-iterable (PYI045)
description:
Checks for __iter__ methods in stubs that return Iterable[T] instead
of an Iterator[T].

title: unused-private-protocol (PYI046)
description: Checks for the presence of unused private typing.Protocol definitions.

title: unused-private-type-alias (PYI047)
description: Checks for the presence of unused private type aliases.

title: stub-body-multiple-statements (PYI048)
description:
Checks for functions in stub (.pyi) files that contain multiple
statements.

title: unused-private-typed-dict (PYI049)
description: Checks for the presence of unused private typing.TypedDict definitions.

title: no-return-argument-annotation-in-stub (PYI050)
description:
Checks for uses of typing.NoReturn (and typing_extensions.NoReturn) for
parameter annotations.

title: redundant-literal-union (PYI051)
description:
Checks for redundant unions between a Literal and a builtin supertype of
that Literal.

title: unannotated-assignment-in-stub (PYI052)
description: Checks for unannotated assignments in stub (.pyi) files.

title: string-or-bytes-too-long (PYI053)
description:
Checks for the use of string and bytes literals longer than 50 characters
in stub (.pyi) files.

title: numeric-literal-too-long (PYI054)
description:
Checks for numeric literals with a string representation longer than ten
characters.

title: unnecessary-type-union (PYI055)
description: Checks for the presence of multiple types in a union.

title: unsupported-method-call-on-all (PYI056)
description:
Checks that append, extend and remove methods are not called on
__all__.

title: byte-string-usage (PYI057)
description: Checks for uses of typing.ByteString or collections.abc.ByteString.

title: generator-return-from-iter-method (PYI058)
description:
Checks for simple __iter__ methods that return Generator, and for
simple __aiter__ methods that return AsyncGenerator.

title: generic-not-last-base-class (PYI059)
description:
Checks for classes inheriting from typing.Generic[] where Generic[] is
not the last base class in the bases tuple.

title: redundant-none-literal (PYI061)
description: Checks for redundant Literal[None] annotations.

title: duplicate-literal-member (PYI062)
description: Checks for duplicate members in a typing.Literal[] slice.

title: pep484-style-positional-only-parameter (PYI063)
description: Checks for the presence of PEP 484-style positional-only parameters.

title: redundant-final-literal (PYI064)
description: Checks for redundant Final[Literal[...]] annotations.

title: bad-version-info-order (PYI066)
description:
Checks for code that branches on sys.version_info comparisons where
branches corresponding to older Python versions come before branches
corresponding to newer Python versions.

title: pytest-fixture-incorrect-parentheses-style (PT001)
description:
Checks for argument-free @pytest.fixture() decorators with or without
parentheses, depending on the lint.flake8-pytest-style.fixture-parentheses
setting.

title: pytest-fixture-positional-args (PT002)
description: Checks for pytest.fixture calls with positional arguments.

title: pytest-extraneous-scope-function (PT003)
description: Checks for pytest.fixture calls with scope="function".

title: pytest-parametrize-names-wrong-type (PT006)
description: Checks for the type of parameter names passed to pytest.mark.parametrize.

title: pytest-parametrize-values-wrong-type (PT007)
description: Checks for the type of parameter values passed to pytest.mark.parametrize.

title: pytest-patch-with-lambda (PT008)
description:
Checks for mocked calls that use a dummy lambda function instead of
return_value.

title: pytest-unittest-assertion (PT009)
description: Checks for uses of assertion methods from the unittest module.

title: pytest-raises-without-exception (PT010)
description: Checks for pytest.raises calls without an expected exception.

title: pytest-raises-too-broad (PT011)
description: Checks for pytest.raises calls without a match or check parameter.

title: pytest-raises-with-multiple-statements (PT012)
description:
Checks for pytest.raises context managers with multiple statements.
This rule allows pytest.raises bodies to contain for
loops with empty bodies (e.g., pass or ... statements), to test
iterator behavior.

title: pytest-incorrect-pytest-import (PT013)
description: Checks for incorrect import of pytest.

title: pytest-duplicate-parametrize-test-cases (PT014)
description: Checks for duplicate test cases in pytest.mark.parametrize.

title: pytest-assert-always-false (PT015)
description: Checks for assert statements whose test expression is a falsy value.

title: pytest-fail-without-message (PT016)
description: Checks for pytest.fail calls without a message.

title: pytest-assert-in-except (PT017)
description: Checks for assert statements in except clauses.

title: pytest-composite-assertion (PT018)
description: Checks for assertions that combine multiple independent conditions.

title: pytest-fixture-param-without-value (PT019)
description:
Checks for pytest test functions that should be decorated with
@pytest.mark.usefixtures.

title: pytest-deprecated-yield-fixture (PT020)
description: Checks for pytest.yield_fixture usage.

title: pytest-fixture-finalizer-callback (PT021)
description: Checks for unnecessary request.addfinalizer usages in pytest fixtures.

title: pytest-useless-yield-fixture (PT022)
description: Checks for unnecessary yield expressions in pytest fixtures.

title: pytest-incorrect-mark-parentheses-style (PT023)
description:
Checks for argument-free @pytest.mark.<marker>() decorators with or
without parentheses, depending on the lint.flake8-pytest-style.mark-parentheses
setting.
The rule defaults to removing unnecessary parentheses,
to match the documentation of the official pytest projects.

title: pytest-unnecessary-asyncio-mark-on-fixture (PT024)
description: Checks for unnecessary @pytest.mark.asyncio decorators applied to fixtures.

title: pytest-erroneous-use-fixtures-on-fixture (PT025)
description:
Checks for pytest.mark.usefixtures decorators applied to pytest
fixtures.

title: pytest-use-fixtures-without-parameters (PT026)
description:
Checks for @pytest.mark.usefixtures() decorators that aren't passed any
arguments.

title: pytest-unittest-raises-assertion (PT027)
description:
Checks for uses of exception-related assertion methods from the unittest
module.

title: pytest-parameter-with-default-argument (PT028)
description: Checks for parameters of test functions with default arguments.

title: pytest-warns-without-warning (PT029)
description: Checks for pytest.warns calls without an expected warning.

title: pytest-warns-too-broad (PT030)
description: Checks for pytest.warns calls without a match parameter.

title: pytest-warns-with-multiple-statements (PT031)
description:
Checks for pytest.warns context managers with multiple statements.
This rule allows pytest.warns bodies to contain for
loops with empty bodies (e.g., pass or ... statements), to test
iterator behavior.

title: bad-quotes-inline-string (Q000)
description:
Checks for inline strings that use single quotes or double quotes,
depending on the value of the lint.flake8-quotes.inline-quotes option.

title: bad-quotes-multiline-string (Q001)
description:
Checks for multiline strings that use single quotes or double quotes,
depending on the value of the lint.flake8-quotes.multiline-quotes
setting.

title: bad-quotes-docstring (Q002)
description:
Checks for docstrings that use single quotes or double quotes, depending
on the value of the lint.flake8-quotes.docstring-quotes setting.

title: avoidable-escaped-quote (Q003)
description:
Checks for strings that include escaped quotes, and suggests changing
the quote style to avoid the need to escape them.

title: unnecessary-escaped-quote (Q004)
description: Checks for strings that include unnecessarily escaped quotes.

title: unnecessary-paren-on-raise-exception (RSE102)
description: Checks for unnecessary parentheses on raised exceptions.

title: unnecessary-return-none (RET501)
description:
Checks for the presence of a return None statement when None is the only
possible return value.

title: implicit-return-value (RET502)
description:
Checks for the presence of a return statement with no explicit value,
for functions that return non-None values elsewhere.

title: implicit-return (RET503)
description:
Checks for missing explicit return statements at the end of functions
that can return non-None values.

title: unnecessary-assign (RET504)
description:
Checks for variable assignments that immediately precede a return of the
assigned variable.

title: superfluous-else-return (RET505)
description:
Checks for else statements with a return statement in the preceding
if block.

title: superfluous-else-raise (RET506)
description:
Checks for else statements with a raise statement in the preceding if
block.

title: superfluous-else-continue (RET507)
description:
Checks for else statements with a continue statement in the preceding
if block.

title: superfluous-else-break (RET508)
description:
Checks for else statements with a break statement in the preceding if
block.

title: private-member-access (SLF001)
description: Checks for accesses on "private" class members.

title: duplicate-isinstance-call (SIM101)
description: Checks for multiple isinstance calls on the same target.

title: collapsible-if (SIM102)
description:
Checks for nested if statements that can be collapsed into a single if
statement.

title: needless-bool (SIM103)
description: Checks for if statements that can be replaced with bool.

title: suppressible-exception (SIM105)
description:
Checks for try-except-pass blocks that can be replaced with the
contextlib.suppress context manager.

title: return-in-try-except-finally (SIM107)
description: Checks for return statements in try-except and finally blocks.

title: if-else-block-instead-of-if-exp (SIM108)
description:
Check for if-else-blocks that can be replaced with a ternary
or binary operator.
The lint is suppressed if the suggested replacement would exceed
the maximum line length configured in pycodestyle.max-line-length.

title: compare-with-tuple (SIM109)
description:
Checks for boolean expressions that contain multiple equality comparisons
to the same value.

title: reimplemented-builtin (SIM110)
description:
Checks for for loops that can be replaced with a builtin function, like
any or all.

title: uncapitalized-environment-variables (SIM112)
description: Check for environment variables that are not capitalized.

title: enumerate-for-loop (SIM113)
description:
Checks for for loops with explicit loop-index variables that can be replaced
with enumerate().
In preview, this rule checks for index variables initialized with any integer rather than only
a literal zero.

title: if-with-same-arms (SIM114)
description: Checks for if branches with identical arm bodies.

title: open-file-with-context-handler (SIM115)
description:
Checks for cases where files are opened (e.g., using the builtin open() function)
without using a context manager.

title: if-else-block-instead-of-dict-lookup (SIM116)
description: Checks for three or more consecutive if-statements with direct returns

title: multiple-with-statements (SIM117)
description:
Checks for the unnecessary nesting of multiple consecutive context
managers.

title: in-dict-keys (SIM118)
description: Checks for key-existence checks against dict.keys() calls.

title: negate-equal-op (SIM201)
description: Checks for negated == operators.

title: negate-not-equal-op (SIM202)
description: Checks for negated != operators.

title: double-negation (SIM208)
description: Checks for double negations (i.e., multiple not operators).

title: if-expr-with-true-false (SIM210)
description: Checks for if expressions that can be replaced with bool() calls.

title: if-expr-with-false-true (SIM211)
description:
Checks for if expressions that can be replaced by negating a given
condition.

title: if-expr-with-twisted-arms (SIM212)
description: Checks for if expressions that check against a negated condition.

title: expr-and-not-expr (SIM220)
description:
Checks for and expressions that include both an expression and its
negation.

title: expr-or-not-expr (SIM221)
description:
Checks for or expressions that include both an expression and its
negation.

title: expr-or-true (SIM222)
description: Checks for or expressions that contain truthy values.

title: expr-and-false (SIM223)
description: Checks for and expressions that contain falsey values.

title: yoda-conditions (SIM300)
description:
Checks for conditions that position a constant on the left-hand side of the
comparison operator, rather than the right-hand side.

title: if-else-block-instead-of-dict-get (SIM401)
description: Checks for if statements that can be replaced with dict.get calls.

title: split-static-string (SIM905)
description: Checks for static str.split calls that can be replaced with list literals.

title: dict-get-with-none-default (SIM910)
description: Checks for dict.get() calls that pass None as the default value.

title: zip-dict-keys-and-values (SIM911)
description: Checks for use of zip() to iterate over keys and values of a dictionary at once.

title: no-slots-in-str-subclass (SLOT000)
description: Checks for subclasses of str that lack a __slots__ definition.

title: no-slots-in-tuple-subclass (SLOT001)
description: Checks for subclasses of tuple that lack a __slots__ definition.

title: no-slots-in-namedtuple-subclass (SLOT002)
description:
Checks for subclasses of collections.namedtuple or typing.NamedTuple
that lack a __slots__ definition.

title: banned-api (TID251)
description: Checks for banned imports.

title: relative-imports (TID252)
description: Checks for relative imports.

title: banned-module-level-imports (TID253)
description:
Checks for module-level imports that should instead be imported lazily
(e.g., within a function definition, or an if TYPE_CHECKING: block, or
some other nested context).

title: lazy-import-mismatch (TID254)
description:
Enforces the configured lazy-import policy in contexts where lazy import
is legal.

title: lazy-import-immediately-resolved (TID255)
description: Checks for lazy imports that are resolved immediately at module load time.

title: invalid-todo-tag (TD001)
description: Checks that a TODO comment is labelled with "TODO".

title: missing-todo-author (TD002)
description: Checks that a TODO comment includes an author.

title: missing-todo-link (TD003)
description:
Checks that a TODO comment is associated with a link to a relevant issue
or ticket.

title: missing-todo-colon (TD004)
description: Checks that a "TODO" tag is followed by a colon.

title: missing-todo-description (TD005)
description:
Checks that a "TODO" tag contains a description of the issue following the
tag itself.

title: invalid-todo-capitalization (TD006)
description:
Checks that a "TODO" tag is properly capitalized (i.e., that the tag is
uppercase).

title: missing-space-after-todo-colon (TD007)
description: Checks that the colon after a "TODO" tag is followed by a space.

title: typing-only-first-party-import (TC001)
description:
Checks for first-party imports that are only used for type annotations, but
aren't defined in a type-checking block.

title: typing-only-third-party-import (TC002)
description:

title: too-many-public-methods (PLR0904)
description:
Checks for classes with too many public methods
By default, this rule allows up to 20 public methods, as configured by
the lint.pylint.max-public-methods option.

title: too-many-return-statements (PLR0911)
description:
Checks for functions or methods with too many return statements.
By default, this rule allows up to six return statements, as configured by
the lint.pylint.max-returns option.

title: too-many-branches (PLR0912)
description:
Checks for functions or methods with too many branches, including (nested)
if, elif, and else branches, for loops, try-except clauses, and
match and case statements.
By default, this rule allows up to 12 branches. This can be configured
using the lint.pylint.max-branches option.

title: too-many-arguments (PLR0913)
description:
Checks for function definitions that include too many arguments.
By default, this rule allows up to five arguments, as configured by the
lint.pylint.max-args option.
This rule exempts methods decorated with @typing.override.
Changing the signature of a subclass method may cause type checkers to
complain about a violation of the Liskov Substitution Principle if it
means that the method now incompatibly overrides a method defined on a
superclass. Explicitly decorating an overriding method with @override
signals to Ruff that the method is intended to override a superclass
method and that a type checker will enforce that it does so; Ruff
therefore knows that it should not enforce rules about methods having
too many arguments.

title: too-many-locals (PLR0914)
description:
Checks for functions that include too many local variables.
By default, this rule allows up to fifteen locals, as configured by the
lint.pylint.max-locals option.

title: too-many-statements (PLR0915)
description:
Checks for functions or methods with too many statements.
By default, this rule allows up to 50 statements, as configured by the
lint.pylint.max-statements option.

title: too-many-boolean-expressions (PLR0916)
description:
Checks for too many Boolean expressions in an if statement.
By default, this rule allows up to 5 expressions. This can be configured
using the lint.pylint.max-bool-expr option.

title: too-many-positional-arguments (PLR0917)
description:
Checks for function definitions that include too many positional arguments.
By default, this rule allows up to five arguments, as configured by the
lint.pylint.max-positional-args option.

title: too-many-nested-blocks (PLR1702)
description:
Checks for functions or methods with too many nested blocks.
By default, this rule allows up to five nested blocks.
This can be configured using the lint.pylint.max-nested-blocks option.

title: redefined-argument-from-local (PLR1704)
description:
Checks for variables defined in for, try, with statements
that redefine function parameters.

title: stop-iteration-return (PLR1708)
description: Checks for explicit raise StopIteration in generator functions.

title: useless-return (PLR1711)
description:
Checks for functions that end with an unnecessary return or
return None, and contain no other return statements.

title: swap-with-temporary-variable (PLR1712)

title: repeated-equality-comparison (PLR1714)
description:
Checks for repeated equality comparisons that can be rewritten as a membership
test.
This rule will try to determine if the values are hashable
and the fix will use a set if they are. If unable to determine, the fix
will use a tuple and suggest the use of a set.

title: boolean-chained-comparison (PLR1716)

title: sys-exit-alias (PLR1722)

title: if-stmt-min-max (PLR1730)
description:
Checks for if statements that can be replaced with min() or max()
calls.

title: unnecessary-dict-index-lookup (PLR1733)

title: unnecessary-list-index-lookup (PLR1736)

comparisons.

argument.

lint.pylint.max-statements-in-try option.

operator.

the operator module.

title: for-loop-writes (FURB122)
description: Checks for the use of IOBase.write in a for loop.

title: readlines-in-for (FURB129)

title: delete-full-slice (FURB131)

dictionary.

calls.

be replaced with itertools.starmap.

using a for loop to call .add() or .discard() on each element

title: slice-copy (FURB145)
description: Checks for unbounded slice expressions to copy a list.

title: unnecessary-enumerate (FURB148)
description:
Checks for uses of enumerate that discard either the index or the value
when iterating over a sequence.

title: math-constant (FURB152)
description: Checks for literals that are similar to constants in math module.

title: repeated-global (FURB154)
description: Checks for consecutive global (or nonlocal) statements.

title: hardcoded-string-charset (FURB156)

is stripped of its leading prefix (i.e., 0b, 0o, or 0x).

title: regex-flag-alias (FURB167)
description:
Checks for the use of shorthand aliases for regular expression flags
(e.g., re.I instead of re.IGNORECASE).

title: isinstance-type-none (FURB168)
description: Checks for uses of isinstance that check if an object is of type None.

title: type-none-comparison (FURB169)
description: Checks for uses of type that compare the type of an object to the type of None.

title: single-item-membership-test (FURB171)
description: Checks for membership tests against single-item containers.

title: implicit-cwd (FURB177)
description: Checks for current-directory lookups using Path().resolve().

title: meta-class-abc-meta (FURB180)
description:
Checks for uses of metaclass=abc.ABCMeta to define abstract base classes
(ABCs).

title: hashlib-digest-hex (FURB181)
description: Checks for the use of .digest().hex() on a hashlib hash, like sha512.

title: list-reverse-copy (FURB187)
description:
Checks for list reversals that can be performed in-place in lieu of
creating a new list.

title: slice-to-remove-prefix-or-suffix (FURB188)
description:
Checks for code that could be written more idiomatically using
str.removeprefix()
or str.removesuffix().
Specifically, the rule flags code that conditionally removes a prefix or suffix
using a slice operation following an if test that uses str.startswith() or str.endswith().
The rule is only applied if your project targets Python 3.9 or later.

title: subclass-builtin (FURB189)
description: Checks for subclasses of dict, list or str.

title: sorted-min-max (FURB192)
description:
Checks for uses of sorted() to retrieve the minimum or maximum value in
a sequence.

title: ambiguous-unicode-character-string (RUF001)
description: Checks for ambiguous Unicode characters in strings.

title: ambiguous-unicode-character-docstring (RUF002)
description: Checks for ambiguous Unicode characters in docstrings.

title: ambiguous-unicode-character-comment (RUF003)
description: Checks for ambiguous Unicode characters in comments.

title: collection-literal-concatenation (RUF005)
description: Checks for uses of the + operator to concatenate collections.

title: asyncio-dangling-task (RUF006)
description:
Checks for asyncio.create_task and asyncio.ensure_future calls
that do not store a reference to the returned result.

title: zip-instead-of-pairwise (RUF007)
description: Checks for use of zip() to iterate over successive pairs of elements.

title: mutable-dataclass-default (RUF008)
description: Checks for mutable default values in dataclass attributes.

title: function-call-in-dataclass-default-argument (RUF009)
description: Checks for function calls in dataclass attribute defaults.

title: explicit-f-string-type-conversion (RUF010)
description:
Checks for uses of str(), repr(), and ascii() as explicit type
conversions within f-strings.

title: mutable-class-default (RUF012)
description: Checks for mutable default values in class attributes.

title: implicit-optional (RUF013)
description:
Checks for the use of implicit Optional in type annotations when the
default parameter value is None.
If lint.future-annotations is set to true, from __future__ import annotations will be added if doing so would allow using the | operator on
a Python version before 3.10.

title: unnecessary-iterable-allocation-for-first-element (RUF015)
description:
Checks the following constructs, all of which can be replaced by
next(iter(...)):
list(...)[0]
tuple(...)[0]
list(i for i in ...)[0]
[i for i in ...][0]
list(...).pop(0)

title: invalid-index-type (RUF016)
description:
Checks for indexed access to lists, strings, tuples, bytes, and comprehensions
using a type other than an integer or slice.

title: quadratic-list-summation (RUF017)
description:
Checks for the use of sum() to flatten lists of lists, which has
quadratic complexity.

title: assignment-in-assert (RUF018)
description:
Checks for named assignment expressions (e.g., x := 0) in assert
statements.

title: unnecessary-key-check (RUF019)
description: Checks for unnecessary key checks prior to accessing a dictionary.

title: never-union (RUF020)
description: Checks for uses of typing.NoReturn and typing.Never in union types.

title: parenthesize-chained-operators (RUF021)
description:
Checks for chained operators where adding parentheses could improve the
clarity of the code.

title: unsorted-dunder-all (RUF022)
description:
Checks for __all__ definitions that are not ordered
according to an "isort-style" sort.
An isort-style sort orders items first according to their casing:
SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE names (conventionally used for global constants)
come first, followed by CamelCase names (conventionally used for
classes), followed by anything else. Within each category,
a natural sort
is used to order the elements.

title: unsorted-dunder-slots (RUF023)
description:
Checks for __slots__ definitions that are not ordered according to a
natural sort.

title: mutable-fromkeys-value (RUF024)
description: Checks for mutable objects passed as a value argument to dict.fromkeys.

title: default-factory-kwarg (RUF026)
description:
Checks for incorrect usages of default_factory as a keyword argument when
initializing a defaultdict.

title: missing-f-string-syntax (RUF027)
description: Searches for strings that look like they were meant to be f-strings, but are missing an f prefix.

title: invalid-formatter-suppression-comment (RUF028)
description:
Checks for formatter suppression comments that are ineffective or incompatible
with Ruff's formatter.

title: unused-async (RUF029)
description:
Checks for functions declared async that do not await or otherwise use features requiring the
function to be declared async.

title: assert-with-print-message (RUF030)
description: Checks for uses of assert expression, print(message).

title: incorrectly-parenthesized-tuple-in-subscript (RUF031)
description:
Checks for consistent style regarding whether nonempty tuples in subscripts
are parenthesized.
The exact nature of this violation depends on the setting
lint.ruff.parenthesize-tuple-in-subscript. By default, the use of
parentheses is considered a violation.
This rule is not applied inside "typing contexts" (type annotations,
type aliases and subscripted class bases), as these have their own specific
conventions around them.

title: decimal-from-float-literal (RUF032)
description: Checks for Decimal calls passing a float literal.

title: post-init-default (RUF033)
description: Checks for __post_init__ dataclass methods with parameter defaults.

title: useless-if-else (RUF034)
description: Checks for useless if-else conditions with identical arms.

title: none-not-at-end-of-union (RUF036)
description: Checks for type annotations where None is not at the end of a union.

title: unnecessary-empty-iterable-within-deque-call (RUF037)
description: Checks for use of collections.deque with an empty iterable as the first argument.

title: redundant-bool-literal (RUF038)
description: Checks for Literal[True, False] type annotations.

title: unraw-re-pattern (RUF039)
description:
Reports the following re and regex calls when
their first arguments are not raw strings:
For regex and re: compile, findall, finditer,
    fullmatch, match, search, split, sub, subn.
regex-specific: splititer, subf, subfn, template.

title: invalid-assert-message-literal-argument (RUF040)
description: Checks for invalid use of literals in assert message arguments.

title: unnecessary-nested-literal (RUF041)
description: Checks for unnecessary nested Literal.

title: pytest-raises-ambiguous-pattern (RUF043)
description:
Checks for non-raw literal string arguments passed to the match parameter
of pytest.raises() where the string contains at least one unescaped
regex metacharacter.

title: implicit-class-var-in-dataclass (RUF045)
description:
Checks for implicit class variables in dataclasses.
Variables matching the lint.dummy-variable-rgx are excluded
from this rule.

title: unnecessary-cast-to-int (RUF046)
description: Checks for int conversions of values that are already integers.

title: needless-else (RUF047)
description: Checks for else clauses that only contains pass and ... statements.

title: map-int-version-parsing (RUF048)
description: Checks for calls of the form map(int, __version__.split(".")).

title: dataclass-enum (RUF049)
description: Checks for enum classes which are also decorated with @dataclass.

title: unnecessary-if (RUF050)
description:
Checks for if statements (without elif or else branches) where the
body contains only pass or ...

title: if-key-in-dict-del (RUF051)
description: Checks for if key in dictionary: del dictionary[key].

title: used-dummy-variable (RUF052)
description:
Checks for "dummy variables" (variables that are named as if to indicate they are unused)
that are in fact used.
By default, "dummy variables" are any variables with names that start with leading
underscores. However, this is customisable using the lint.dummy-variable-rgx setting).

title: class-with-mixed-type-vars (RUF053)
description:
Checks for classes that have PEP 695
while also inheriting from typing.Generic or typing_extensions.Generic.

title: indented-form-feed (RUF054)
description: Checks for form feed characters preceded by either a space or a tab.

title: unnecessary-regular-expression (RUF055)
description: Checks for uses of the re module that can be replaced with builtin str methods.

title: falsy-dict-get-fallback (RUF056)
description: Checks for dict.get(key, falsy_value) calls in boolean test positions.

title: unnecessary-round (RUF057)
description: Checks for round() calls that have no effect on the input.

title: starmap-zip (RUF058)
description: Checks for itertools.starmap calls where the second argument is a zip call.

title: unused-unpacked-variable (RUF059)
description: Checks for the presence of unused variables in unpacked assignments.

title: in-empty-collection (RUF060)
description: Checks for membership tests on empty collections (such as list, tuple, set, or dict).

title: legacy-form-pytest-raises (RUF061)
description: Checks for non-context-manager use of pytest.raises, pytest.warns, and pytest.deprecated_call.

title: access-annotations-from-class-dict (RUF063)
description:
Checks for uses of foo.__dict__.get("__annotations__") or
foo.__dict__["__annotations__"] on Python 3.10+ and Python < 3.10 when
lint.typing-extensions is enabled.

title: non-octal-permissions (RUF064)
description:
Checks for standard library functions which take a numeric mode argument
where a non-octal integer literal is passed.

title: logging-eager-conversion (RUF065)
description: Checks for eager string conversion of arguments to logging calls.

title: property-without-return (RUF066)
description: Detects class @property methods that does not have a return statement.

title: non-empty-init-module (RUF067)
description: Detects the presence of code in __init__.py files.

title: duplicate-entry-in-dunder-all (RUF068)
description: Detects duplicate elements in __all__ definitions.

title: float-equality-comparison (RUF069)
description: Checks for comparisons between floating-point values using == or !=.

title: unnecessary-assign-before-yield (RUF070)
description:
Checks for variable assignments that immediately precede a yield (or
yield from) of the assigned variable, where the variable is not
referenced anywhere else.

title: os-path-commonprefix (RUF071)
description: Checks for uses of os.path.commonprefix.

title: useless-finally (RUF072)
description: Checks for finally clauses that only contain pass or ... statements

title: f-string-percent-format (RUF073)
description: Checks for uses of the % operator on f-strings.

title: incorrect-decorator-order (RUF074)
description: Checks for incorrect ordering of decorators on functions and methods.

title: fallible-context-manager (RUF075)
description:
Checks for @contextlib.contextmanager decorated functions that contain
yield expressions not protected against exceptions.

title: unused-noqa (RUF100)
description: Checks for noqa directives that are no longer applicable.

title: redirected-noqa (RUF101)
description: Checks for noqa directives that use redirected rule codes.

title: invalid-rule-code (RUF102)
description: Checks for noqa codes that are invalid.

title: invalid-suppression-comment (RUF103)
description: Checks for invalid suppression comments

title: unmatched-suppression-comment (RUF104)
description: Checks for unmatched range suppression comments

title: noqa-comments (RUF105)
description: Checks for the use of noqa comments instead of Ruff-specific ruff: ignore comments.

title: rule-codes-in-suppression-comments (RUF106)
description: Checks for rule codes in Ruff-specific suppression comments.

title: invalid-pyproject-toml (RUF200)
description: Checks for any pyproject.toml that does not conform to the schema from the relevant PEPs.

title: rule-codes-in-selectors (RUF201)
description: Checks for any configuration files that use rule codes as selectors.

title: raise-vanilla-class (TRY002)
description: Checks for code that raises Exception or BaseException directly.

title: raise-vanilla-args (TRY003)
description:
Checks for long exception messages that are not defined in the exception
class itself.

title: type-check-without-type-error (TRY004)
description: Checks for type checks that do not raise TypeError.

title: verbose-raise (TRY201)
description: Checks for needless exception names in raise statements.

title: useless-try-except (TRY203)
description: Checks for immediate uses of raise within exception handlers.

title: try-consider-else (TRY300)
description: Checks for return statements in try blocks.

title: raise-within-try (TRY301)
description:
Checks for raise statements within try blocks. The only raises
caught are those that throw exceptions caught by the try statement itself.

title: error-instead-of-exception (TRY400)
description:
Checks for uses of logging.error instead of logging.exception when
logging an exception.

title: verbose-log-message (TRY401)
description: Checks for excessive logging of exception objects.
